profile_text.body:
Accenture plc describes itself as a company that embraces change to create 360-degree value and shared success for clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities, working across industries and around the world with emerging technologies and human ingenuity. It highlights Accenture Construct, a new global business that brings together advisory, engineering, delivery, digital and AI to orchestrate capital projects from strategy through execution and operation.

The company's site frames much of its current work around AI. It describes a Human + AI era in which leaders can redesign work, accelerate skills and reinvent HR so people and AI work together to create measurable growth, stronger experiences and lasting enterprise value. It says that after two years of rapid AI acceleration, global executives enter 2026 with confidence, but data shows gaps standing in the way of scale and value. The site also discusses AI pushing power demand beyond grid limits, with data center developers shifting to a power-first strategy, and describes cyber resilience as a strategic mandate in an AI driven threat landscape. It states Accenture is helping the European Commission's Directorate-General for International Partnerships to scale AI across global operations.

Accenture plc is a for-profit public company traded under ticker ACN, with headquarters in Dublin and SEC Central Index Key 0001467373.
